title: Android scholar-input exchange contract v0.1 (freeze)
operations: Froze Android<->desktop scholar-input exchange contract v0.1 (normative MUST/SHOULD/MAY).
Ownership boundary: Android is capture-only; ceiling raw_captured; all governance desktop-side.
Transport v0.1 = JSON file export/import (A); B/C/D future.
Envelope design: flat JSON object = scholar_input payload + ignored mobile metadata siblings (client_record_id etc.); no backend schema change.
Fixed values schema_version=0.2, record_type=scholar_input_not_evidence, source=android_app, status=raw_captured.
Batch semantics: single + array; atomic all-or-nothing refusal; hash-based duplicate skip; no per-record quarantine.
Duplicate semantics by canonical content hash; documented non-blocking gap (dup ack lacks existing KP-SI id).
Acknowledgement + error-code + mobile-state + security/privacy contracts specified.
Validated 3 input fixtures through importer on disposable DB copy; live DB untouched (scholar_input=0).
